grade.summary: The submission correctly classifies all solutions as f(x)=x+c with c≥0. It verifies the family, derives the orbit identity and nonnegativity of g=f−id, proves all positive values of g coincide using a limsup argument along forward orbits, and excludes coexistence of zero and positive defect values through an interval-expansion argument. The briefly stated interval iteration facts are routine and directly verifiable.
strengths: Correctly obtains f(f(y))=2f(y)−y and hence f^n(y)=y+ng(y).
Uses positivity of all iterates to prove g≥0.
The limsup/orbit argument validly shows every positive value of g equals one constant.
The interval-exclusion and expansion argument correctly rules out mixed values 0 and L.
The converse verification is complete and sign-safe.
